intro: Priestess Josetta is a human priest trainer stationed on the upper floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Dedicated to guiding novices of the Holy Light beyond their initial trials in Northshire, she mentors young priests in faith, devotion, and practical ministry.

p: While many who take holy vows spend their days within grand cathedrals or cloistered monasteries, Priestess Josetta ministers directly among the common folk of Elwynn Forest. From her modest quarters upstairs in the bustling Lion's Pride Inn, she attends to the spiritual health of travelers, guards, and local laborers alike, demonstrating that service to the Holy Light requires presence wherever hearts need solace.

Josetta plays a vital role for budding priests who have completed their initial studies at Northshire Abbey. She instructs them in the practical realities of their calling, sending them into the surrounding countryside to aid wounded guards and comfort the afflicted. Through these tasks, she emphasizes that clerical duties are not merely about learning words of prayer, but actively channeling the Light to mend a broken world.

Despite her steady devotion, Josetta carries a touch of wistfulness regarding her life's choices. In her youth, she lacked the courage to step onto the wider roads and explore Azeroth, choosing instead the safety of familiar ground. Though content in her sacred service in Goldshire, she often urges the young disciples who cross her threshold to be bolder than she was and take their faith to distant frontiers.
